value.name: waiter serves champagne
value.description: A waiter pours champagne for Marylin and Miles at the restaurant table.
evidence: as a waiter pours them champagne.

value.name: Miles toasts to victory
value.description: Miles raises his glass and proposes a toast to victory.

value.name: Marylin rejects celebration
value.description: Marylin says she does not feel victorious and instead feels betrayed, abandoned, and humiliated.
evidence:
MARYLIN
I don't feel victorious Miles. I
feel betrayed, abandoned and
humiliated.

value.name: Marylin reveals incriminating photos
value.description: Marylin tells Miles she has pictures of her husband with another woman.
evidence:
I have pictures of him
with another woman...

value.name: Miles jokes about more pictures
value.description: Miles responds with a teasing remark about Marylin having even more pictures.
evidence:
MILES
More pictures? My God, Marylin. You
can open an erotic art gallery.

value.name: Marylin accuses Miles of mocking her
value.description: Marylin asks whether Miles invited her just to make cheap jokes at her expense.
evidence:
MARYLIN
Did you invite me here to score some
cheap laughs.

value.name: Miles claims he came to comfort her
value.description: Miles says he invited Marylin to comfort and appreciate her rather than ridicule her.
evidence:
MILES
No. Just to comfort you, and
appreciate you --

value.name: Marylin accuses Miles of judging her morality
value.description: Marylin says Miles thinks she engineered the divorce and lacks morality or soul, then compares him to her mother.
evidence:
You really think I engineered the
whole thing. You think the marriage
and the divorce was part of some
scheme. You came here to celebrate
because you think I'm without morality
or soul. You --

value.name: waiter interrupts to ask about ordering
value.description: The waiter hands Miles a menu and asks whether they should order.
evidence:
The Waiter hands Miles a menu.
WAITER
Should we order?

value.name: Marylin declines food
value.description: Marylin starts to agree to order but trails off, indicating she is not really hungry.
evidence:
MARYLIN
Yes, I -- well, I'm not really...

value.name: Miles mirrors her lack of appetite
value.description: Miles says he is not hungry either, matching Marylin's reluctance to eat.
evidence:
MILES
Not hungry, huh? Neither am I.

value.name: Miles takes Marylin's hand
value.description: After a pensive pause, Miles reaches across the table, takes Marylin's hand, and strokes it while she allows the gesture.
evidence:
Miles reaches across the table and takes her hand. She lets
him. He strokes it.
